sentences.text: Slow English Podcast, A1 Love Host, Emili.
Topics, Sapa, part one.
Hello, everyone.
My name is Emili.
Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
Today, we talk about a beautiful and less known city.
The city is Sapa.
Sapa is in Vietnam.
Vietnam is a country in Southeast Asia.
Sapa is in the north of the country.
It is in the mountains.
Many people visit Sapa for nature and fresh air.
Part two.
Sapa is famous for its mountains and rice terraces.
Rice terraces are steps on hills where people grow rice.
These terraces are green and very beautiful.
They look like stairs on the mountains.
Part three.
The weather in Sapa is cooler than many other places in Vietnam.
Because it is in the mountains, the air is fresh.
Sometimes there is fog and the mountains look mysterious.
Many visitors enjoy this atmosphere.
Part four.
Sapa is home to different ethnic groups.
These groups have their own languages, clothes and traditions.
Some people wear colorful traditional clothes every day.
Visitors can learn about their culture.
Part five.
Markets in Sapa are very interesting.
People from villages come to sell their products.
They sell clothes, bags, food and handmade items.
The markets are colorful and lively.
Part six.
Many visitors go trekking in Sapa.
Trekking means walking long distances in nature.
People walk through mountains, villages and rice fields.
Local guides help visitors during the trek.
Part seven.
The views in Sapa are amazing.
You can see mountains, valleys and rivers.
The rice fields change color during the year.
Sometimes they are green and sometimes they are golden.
Part eight.
Food in Sapa is simple and tasty.
People eat rice, vegetables and meat.
Hot soup is popular especially in cool weather.
Fresh food from local farms is very common.
Part nine.
Life in Sapa is calm and peaceful.
Many people live in small villages.
They work in farming and take care of animals.
Family and community are very important.
Part ten.
Sapa is also known for its local crafts.
People make clothes, bags and decorations by hand.
These items are colorful and unique.
Visitors like to buy them as souvenirs.
Part eleven.
Sunrise and sunset in Sapa are very beautiful.
The sky changes color over the mountains.
Clouds move slowly across the hills.
It is a perfect place for photos and quiet moments.
Part twelve.
Sapa is a peaceful city with beautiful nature and rich culture.
The mountains, rice terraces and friendly people make it special.
Visitors can relax, explore and learn new things.
Even though Sapa is not very famous, it is a wonderful place to visit.
